module.purpose: Constructs the Redux slices (reducers + actions) for RTK Query's internal state: queries, mutations, invalidation tags, subscriptions, and config. Used by createApi to assemble the root reducer.
module.summary: This module builds the combined reducer and action creators for an RTK Query API instance. It defines helper functions to safely update query and mutation substates, computes mutation cache keys, and creates individual Redux slices for queries, mutations, invalidation/tag tracking, subscriptions, and configuration. It wires extraReducers to handle pending/fulfilled/rejected thunk lifecycles, rehydration, and online/focus events. The builder returns a combined reducer and a map of all actions.
module.businessContext: Core internal state management for RTK Query caching layer. If broken, API caching, invalidation, and refetch-on-focus/online fail.

detail.name: getMutationCacheKey
detail.signature:
export function getMutationCacheKey(id: MutationSubstateIdentifier | { requestId: string; arg: { fixedCacheKey?: string | undefined } }): string
export function getMutationCacheKey(id: { fixedCacheKey?: string; requestId?: string }): string | undefined

parameters.name: id
parameters.type: MutationSubstateIdentifier | { fixedCacheKey?: string; requestId?: string } | { requestId: string; arg: { fixedCacheKey?: string | undefined } }

preconditions: The id argument must be an object whose shape matches one of the three union members: a MutationSubstateIdentifier, an object with optional fixedCacheKey and requestId, or an object with a required requestId and an arg sub-object containing optional fixedCacheKey.
postconditions: Returns a string when at least one of fixedCacheKey (from either the top-level or the arg sub-object) or requestId is defined.
Returns undefined when both fixedCacheKey and requestId resolve to undefined.
The return value is never null or any other type; it is strictly string or undefined.
invariants: The return value is either a string or undefined, never null.
The function is deterministic: identical input always produces identical output.
The 'arg' in id discriminant check determines whether fixedCacheKey is read from the top-level id or from id.arg.
Nullish coalescing (??) is used for fallback, meaning only null and undefined trigger the requestId fallback, not empty strings.
edgeCases: id has an arg property with a defined arg.fixedCacheKey: returns arg.fixedCacheKey.
id has an arg property with undefined arg.fixedCacheKey but a defined requestId: returns requestId.

id has an arg property with both arg.fixedCacheKey and requestId undefined: returns undefined (but the first overload contract says requestId is required, so this combination only occurs under the second overload).
id has no arg property but a defined top-level fixedCacheKey: returns fixedCacheKey.
id has no arg property, undefined fixedCacheKey, but a defined requestId: returns requestId.
id has no arg property and both fixedCacheKey and requestId undefined: returns undefined.
id.arg.fixedCacheKey is an empty string (""): returns the empty string, because ?? does not fall back on falsy non-nullish values.
detail.summary: Generates a mutation cache key from a substate identifier, preferring a defined fixedCacheKey and falling back to the requestId when fixedCacheKey is absent or undefined.

detail.name: buildSlice
detail.signature: export function buildSlice({ reducerPath, queryThunk, mutationThunk, serializeQueryArgs, context: { endpointDefinitions: definitions, apiUid, extractRehydrationInfo, hasRehydrationInfo }, assertTagType, config }: { reducerPath: string; queryThunk: QueryThunk; infiniteQueryThunk: InfiniteQueryThunk<any>; mutationThunk: MutationThunk; serializeQueryArgs: InternalSerializeQueryArgs; context: ApiContext<EndpointDefinitions>; assertTagType: AssertTagTypes; config: Omit<ConfigState<string>, 'online' | 'focused' | 'middlewareRegistered'> })
preconditions: reducerPath must be a non-empty string used to namespace all generated action types
context.endpointDefinitions must contain endpoint definitions keyed by endpoint name
serializeQueryArgs must be a callable function that produces stable query cache keys from query arguments
assertTagType must be provided for tag type validation at the slice level
config must be a ConfigState<string> object that omits the 'online', 'focused', and 'middlewareRegistered' keys
postconditions: A querySlice is created with name {reducerPath}/queries, initialState derived from initialState, and reducers removeQueryResult, cacheEntriesUpserted, queryResultPatched
A mutationSlice is created with name {reducerPath}/mutations, initialState derived from initialState, and reducer removeMutationResult
An invalidationSlice is created with name {reducerPath}/invalidation, initialState { tags: {}, keys: {} }, and reducer updateProvidedBy
A resetApiState action creator is created whose action type is {reducerPath}/resetApiState
All action types across all slices are consistently namespaced under {reducerPath}/{sliceName}
invariants: Action type prefixes consistently follow the pattern {reducerPath}/{sliceName} for all generated slices and actions
In-flight (pending) query and mutation entries are never rehydrated — only FULFILLED and REJECTED entries are restored from persisted state
Mutation substates are only tracked when the mutation thunk arg has track === true
Upsert query updates preserve the existing requestId on the substate; inserts always assign a new requestId from the request meta
Query cache keys are always derived via serializeQueryArgs for consistency, never constructed ad hoc
Rehydration never restores entries whose status differs from FULFILLED or REJECTED, preventing stale in-flight data from overwriting active requests
edgeCases: Upsert query insert vs update: writePendingCacheEntry keeps the current requestId when upserting an existing entry (update) but replaces it for new entries (insert)
Infinite queries with a 'direction' property on the thunk arg: direction is stored on the InfiniteQuerySubState as InfiniteQueryDirection
Endpoint definition with structuralSharing === false: cached data is assigned directly without copyWithStructuralSharing
Endpoint definition with a custom merge function and existing cached data: merge callback receives the existing draft data and payload, with Immer handling the returned value assignment
Endpoint definition with no merge function and no existing data: fresh response data is cached directly via copyWithStructuralSharing or direct assignment
Mutation thunk arg with track === false: mutation substate is not created, updated, or cleaned up
Query result cleanup via removeQueryResult: cache key is deleted from both the query state and the invalidation tag registry
Tag without an explicit id: stored under the '__internal_without_id' key in the invalidation tags state
Rehydration of persisted state: entries with pending status are skipped; only fulfilled or rejected entries are restored

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: buildSlice does not validate configuration at creation time; individual reducers within the slices use conditional guards (requestId matching, upserting flag, track flag, status checks) to silently skip stale or irrelevant state updates without throwing

stateMutations: Creates and returns three Redux Toolkit slices whose Immer-powered reducers mutate draft QueryState, MutationState, and InvalidationState objects
querySlice reducers mutate draft state: removeQueryResult deletes cache entries; cacheEntriesUpserted writes pending then fulfilled entries; queryResultPatched applies Immer patches to existing data
mutationSlice reducers mutate draft state: removeMutationResult deletes mutation cache entries; pending/fulfilled/rejected cases create, update, or error mutation substates
invalidationSlice reducers mutate draft state: updateProvidedBy registers query cache keys under tags and keys; removeQueryResult cascades cache key removal from tags
resetApiState action creator is created as a standalone action with no payload, dispatched to signal full state reset to the apiSlice middleware
detail.ioFormatSpec: Redux state tree with three slices: queries (QueryState<any>), mutations (MutationState<any>), and invalidation (InvalidationState<string> with { tags: {}, keys: {} }). Action types follow the pattern {reducerPath}/{slice}/{reducer} for slice reducers and {reducerPath}/resetApiState for the reset action. Auto-batched actions carry meta with SHOULD_AUTOBATCH=true, requestId (nanoid), and timestamp (Date.now()) keys. Rehydration actions carry { queries, mutations, provided } extracted via extractRehydrationInfo.
detail.summary: Factory function that constructs three Redux Toolkit slices (query, mutation, and invalidation state) plus a resetApiState action creator, all namespaced under the provided reducerPath; returns the slices and action creator for integration into the RTK Query API reducer.

Default tag ID key in invalidation state used when a provided tag has no explicit id

units.name: writePendingCacheEntry

detail.name: writePendingCacheEntry
detail.signature: function writePendingCacheEntry(draft: QueryState<any>, arg: QueryThunkArg, upserting: boolean, meta: { arg: QueryThunkArg; requestId: string; startedTimeStamp: number })

parameters.name: meta
parameters.type: { arg: QueryThunkArg; requestId: string; startedTimeStamp: number }

preconditions: The draft object must be a valid QueryState<any> (a record-style object where keys map to substate entries).
The arg parameter must contain a string property queryCacheKey used to identify the cache entry.
The meta parameter must contain a string property requestId and a numeric startedTimeStamp.
The upserting flag must reflect whether this call is part of an upsertQuery operation.
If arg.originalArgs is defined, the entry's originalArgs will be overwritten with its value.
postconditions: draft[arg.queryCacheKey] exists and is an object with status STATUS_PENDING after execution.
If the entry did not previously exist, it is initialized with status STATUS_UNINITIALIZED before being set to STATUS_PENDING.

The requestId on the substate is set as follows: - If upserting is true AND a requestId already exists on the substate, the existing requestId is preserved. - Otherwise, the requestId is set to meta.requestId.
If arg.originalArgs is defined, substate.originalArgs is set to arg.originalArgs.
invariants: The substate.status is always STATUS_PENDING after this function runs, regardless of prior state.
The substate.requestId is always a string value (either the existing one or meta.requestId).
The originalArgs field is only updated when arg.originalArgs is not undefined.
edgeCases: When draft[arg.queryCacheKey] does not exist: a new entry is created with status STATUS_UNINITIALIZED and endpointName derived from arg, then updated to STATUS_PENDING.
When upserting is true and an existing requestId is present: the existing requestId is kept rather than replaced with meta.requestId.
When upserting is true but no existing requestId exists: the entry behaves like a new insert and uses meta.requestId.
When arg.originalArgs is undefined: the originalArgs field on the substate is left unchanged.
When the key already exists with a different status: the status is overwritten to STATUS_PENDING.
stateMutations: Mutates draft[arg.queryCacheKey] by initializing it if absent and setting its status to STATUS_PENDING.
Mutates substate.status to STATUS_PENDING via updateQuerySubstateIfExists.
Mutates substate.requestId conditionally based on upserting flag and existing value.
Mutates substate.originalArgs when arg.originalArgs is defined.
detail.summary: Mutates the draft QueryState to set the cache entry for the given queryCacheKey into STATUS_PENDING, assigning the requestId based on whether the entry already exists or is being upserted, and preserving originalArgs if defined.

detail.name: removeCacheKeyFromTags
detail.signature: function removeCacheKeyFromTags(draft: Draft<{ [cacheKey: string]: any }>, cacheKey: string, tags: string[]): void
preconditions: draft must be a mutable Immer draft object
cacheKey must be a non-empty string
tags must be an array of strings
postconditions: For every tag in tags, if the tag maps to an array containing cacheKey, cacheKey is removed from that array
The tag arrays are left intact for other cacheKeys
No tag is deleted entirely when cacheKey is present
invariants: Tags unrelated to cacheKey are not mutated
Each tag's cacheKey array remains a valid array after mutation
edgeCases: If cacheKey is not present in a tag's cacheKey array, that tag is left unchanged
If a tag does not exist in the draft, it is created as an array containing only cacheKey before removal
If tags is an empty array, no mutations occur
stateMutations: draft[tag] is mutated for each tag that contains cacheKey, with cacheKey removed from the array
new arrays may be created for tags that don't yet exist
detail.summary: Removes the given cacheKey from all provided tags within the current query cache draft. It iterates the provided tags, locates any entries referencing the cacheKey via the tag's associated cacheKey array, and removes the cacheKey from that array, leaving the tag intact for other cacheKeys.

specLiterals.role: Represents the value returned by indexOf when cacheKey is not found, used to conditionally remove cacheKey from tag arrays

detail.signature: function writeProvidedTagsForQueries(state: InvalidationState, actions: Array<{ queryCacheKey: QueryCacheKey; providedTags: readonly FullTagDescription<string>[] }>): void

parameters.name: actions
parameters.type: Array<{ queryCacheKey: QueryCacheKey; providedTags: readonly FullTagDescription<string>[] }>

preconditions: The `state` argument must be a valid InvalidationState with a `providedTags` map.
Each entry in `actions` must contain a `queryCacheKey` and a `providedTags` array of `FullTagDescription<string>`.
postconditions: For every action, the `state.providedTags` map is updated so that the entry for `queryCacheKey` contains the provided tags.
Existing tags for the same cache key are merged with new tags rather than overwritten.
invariants: The `providedTags` map always maps `QueryCacheKey` values to arrays of `FullTagDescription<string>`.
No cache key in `actions` is `undefined` or `null`.
edgeCases: If `actions` is empty, no mutation occurs to `state`.
If a `queryCacheKey` already has associated tags, the new tags are merged into the existing set.
If `providedTags` is an empty array for a given key, that key may be set to an empty tag array.
stateMutations: state.providedTags[queryCacheKey] is updated or created for each action
detail.summary: Processes a list of query cache actions and writes the provided tags into the invalidation state, mapping each cache key to its associated tag descriptions.
